Eligibility and proof

Who is eligible

  • Serving and retired members of India’s Armed Forces, Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) and Assam Rifles
  • Their spouses, parents and children
  • Family members may book and travel independently; the service member does not need to travel

Proof you must show

  • A service ID, veteran or pensioner card, or other acceptable proof, shown at check-in
  • Family members can confirm their relationship with our team in advance

No promo code or document upload is needed to enquire; please do not send service documents through the enquiry form. If the usual proof is not available, speak with us before paying so we can agree an alternative.

Defence and Paramilitary Forces

We, at Kairali, salute the indomitable spirit of our brave soldiers, who weather harshest terrains and conditions to ensure the safety and integrity of our great nation. Whether there is an attack from the enemy along the border or some natural calamity affecting the people within the country, you are always there to help and save others lives by sacfrificing years. Our Army, Navy, and Air force are the pride of the nation, and we would like to thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Your body goes through so many rigors on daily basis that there is a want to tend to its needs also. As a small token of our gratitude, we would like to invite you to rejuvenate your body at Kairali’s Ayurvedic Healing Village located at Palakkad in Kerala. With the help of our authentic Ayurvedic Healing Programs along with yoga and meditation training, your body will be rid of all toxins and stresses, helping you feel reinvigorated. Kairali is offering up to 20% discount enchantingly on all our treatment packages at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village for our defense and paramilitary force personnel and their family members.

Come and experience the combined power of Ayurveda, Yoga and Meditation & revitalize yourself from within.

About Kairali

KAIRALI AYURVEDIC GROUP is headed by joint Managing Directors Mrs. Gita Ramesh and Mr. K.V. Ramesh, both of whom hail from a long family lineage of traditional Ayurvedic doctors. Blessed with a legacy of expertise emanating from such renowned physicians as the late Dr. Sankunny Vaidiar (grandfather of Mr. K. V. Ramesh) and the Dr. K. S. Vasudevan (father of Mr. K. V. Ramesh), Kairali Group was established on a solid ground of Ayurveda research. Since its inception, Kairali has built on the achievements of its forefathers, developing its product infrastructure to make a diverse range of Ayurvedic products available to a multi-national audience.

TREATMENT CENTRES Keen to promote the healing effects of an Ayurvedic lifestyle, Kairali established our first Treatment Centre in New Delhi, 1989. The success of the treatments and therapies provided there led to the proliferation of demand for Kairali facilities. Our Treatment Centres can now be found throughout India, and we remain an industry favourite for education and staff training. Our regular workshops and training courses attract the participation of doctors, dieticians and therapists from all over the world.

HOSPITALITY & HEALTHCARE With an excellent infrastructure firmly in place, Kairali established their signature Kerala Retreat in 1997. An award-winning retreat centre set in the inspiring tropical forest location of Palakkad, The Ayurvedic Healing Village offers the epitome of modern holistic luxury. The retreat centre is surrounded by fifty acres of organic herbal farmland, and represents a sustainable healing community for guests seeking Panchakarma, detox and yoga retreats. Since the establishment of their Hospitality division, Kairali’s international profile has grown significantly, leading to two further resorts in India, and the proliferation of spa franchises over three continents.

AYURVEDIC MEDICINE Kairali’s Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies have an impressive legacy in the family’s heritage. Established in 1948 by Dr. K. S. Vasudevan, father of Mr. K.V. Ramesh, Spalabs has been responsible for the creation of several best-selling formulas and health supplements. Based on authentic Ayurvedic ingredients and the traditional processes of our ancient scripture, these original recipes have undergone continuous improvement over the course of the last sixty years, resulting in our modern range of Ayurvedic Herbal Remedies. Kairali’s wide range of Ayurvedic products includes a hundred authentic herbal medicines, skin care, body products and spa equipment, available to our partners and spa franchisees for distribution at their outlets.

Where we are

Kairali sits in Palakkad district, inland Kerala, in the south west of India.
